# isValidSheetName

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is a sheet name.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isValidSheetName() — Checks whether a value is a sheet name. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isValidSheetName(value: unknown): value is string;
```

What Google Sheets accepts: at most 100 characters, not blank, none of `\ / ? * [ ]`, and not the reserved name `history` in any case.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| :-------- | :-------- | :------------------ |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is a sheet name; otherwise `false`.

In TypeScript the guard narrows `value` to `string` inside the branch.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
isValidSheetName("Data"); // => true
isValidSheetName("Report 2026"); // => true
isValidSheetName("history"); // => false
isValidSheetName("Data/2026"); // => false
isValidSheetName(""); // => false
```
